'''Genter Fosse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who was allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], he was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Genter Fosse first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Bounty Hunter class trainer on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" />
